lifecycle.activation_contract: Enable the ECPA Bundle and set VLLM_HUST_GDN_STATE_CODEC_ENABLE=1 only for explicit experiments; a compatible host source guard must pass.
lifecycle.rollback_contract: Set VLLM_HUST_GDN_STATE_CODEC_KILL_SWITCH=1 or disable the org.vllm-hust.gdn-state-codec Bundle and restart vLLM.
